question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f0076b1a27bdadd355cad0aabf46266d3674c9cbf30028d483f45afb8634025.png]
solution:
**Logic followed in the figure series: **

The figure is rotating 45° clockwise in every next figure and the number of lines inside the figure is increasing by 1 in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc34af49f0ff3a8dc4a7e3fdffdcd04f3da7589d63c2e1596a4d430f5a7b1204.png] 

∴ Figure in Option 2 will replace the (?) mark.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
